education.title: About Daily Horoscope
education.disclaimer: Zodiac sign profiles are offered for personal interest, cultural exploration and reflection. They describe traditional symbolism, are not scientifically proven, and are not predictions or professional advice.

p.0: The zodiac is a belt of sky that the Sun, Moon and planets appear to travel through. Astrology divides that belt into twelve equal parts of 30 degrees each, and each part is called a sign. The signs carry the names of Aries, Taurus, Gemini and the rest, and each is associated with an element and a traditional set of themes.
p.1: Your Sun sign is the sign the Sun was in when you were born. It is the sign most people mean when they say "I'm a Leo". It is a popular starting point for exploring astrology, and this page is useful if you are curious about the personality themes traditionally linked with each sign, or about the signs of people you know.

list.0: Explore the wheel. Tap any sign to see its dates, element, ruling planet and a short description. The wheel also cycles through the signs by itself until you tap one.
list.1: Filter by element if you want to compare Fire, Earth, Air or Water signs side by side.
list.2: Open a sign's card to read its full profile: core traits, strengths, areas to watch and traditionally compatible signs.

after.0: This Seva does not ask for your name or birth details, and it uses no generated text. Every description is fixed text written for Bhagya Astro, so the same sign always shows the same profile.

p.0: A Sun sign is found by date. Find the range your birthday falls in and you have your sign. The table lists the commonly used Western (tropical) date ranges that this Seva shows.

after.0: These are approximate. The Sun changes sign on a slightly different date and time from year to year, and the clock time depends on your time zone, so if you were born within a day or so of a boundary your Sun sign may differ from the table. A calculation from your exact birth time and place, by a qualified astrologer or chart software, can settle it.
after.1: Western astrology uses the tropical zodiac, which is tied to the seasons. Vedic (Indian) astrology uses the sidereal zodiac, which is tied to the stars, and the two are roughly 24 degrees (about three and a half weeks) apart. For many birthdays this means your Vedic Sun sign is the sign before your Western one, and Vedic astrology often gives as much weight to the Moon sign (Rashi) and rising sign (Lagna) as to the Sun sign. The dates on this page are the Western ones.
after.2: Where two rulers are shown, the first is the modern one and the second is the traditional one. Scorpio, Aquarius and Pisces were assigned Mars, Saturn and Jupiter before Pluto, Uranus and Neptune were discovered, and traditions still differ on which to use.

list.1: Ruler: the planet traditionally associated with the sign. It is part of the symbolism of the sign and does not tell you where any planet is today.

education.title: About Janma Kundali
education.disclaimer: This profile is offered for personal interest, cultural exploration and reflection. Astrology and numerology are traditional belief systems that are not scientifically proven, and the profile is not a prediction or professional advice.

paragraphs.0: A Janma Kundali is the Vedic birth chart: a map of the sky at the exact moment and place you were born. Vedic astrologers read it from the signs (Rashis), lunar mansions (Nakshatras) and houses that the Sun, Moon and planets occupied.
paragraphs.1: This Seva calculates the key parts of that chart: your Surya Rashi (Sun sign), Chandra Rashi (Moon sign), Janma Nakshatra and its pada, the Lagna (ascendant) with the planets in their Rashis and houses when you give an exact birth time, and the Panchang of your birth. It also shows a numerology Life Path number, which is a separate tradition.

list.0: Your birth date, time and birthplace are used. The birthplace gives the latitude, longitude and time zone, so your local time is converted correctly to the real moment of birth.
list.1: Planet positions come from a high-precision astronomical ephemeris. They are shifted to the sidereal (Nirayana) zodiac using the Lahiri ayanamsa, the standard used in India.
list.2: The Lagna is the sign rising on the eastern horizon at your birth time and place. Houses are counted whole-sign, with the Lagna sign as the 1st house.
list.3: The Panchang (Hindu month, Paksha, Tithi, Nakshatra, Yoga, Karana, Vara) comes from the real positions of the Sun and Moon, not from a calendar table.

after.0: The Rashi, Nakshatra, Lagna and Panchang are calculated for you. The written descriptions of each Rashi and the Life Path insights are traditional text written once for each sign or number.

b2.heading: What If I Don't Know My Birth Time?

list.0: Surya Rashi and Chandra Rashi are stated only when the Sun or Moon stays in one sign for the whole day at your birthplace. If it changes sign that day, both possibilities are shown and marked uncertain.
list.1: The Lagna, the houses and the planets' house placements are not calculated and are never guessed.
list.2: The Moon's pada and the Vimshottari dasha need your exact birth time, so they are left out. The Panchang is worked out for local sunrise, and anything that changes during the day is marked uncertain.

after.0: If your birth time is only approximate, remember that the Lagna moves to the next sign about every two hours and advances roughly 1° every four minutes.

paragraphs.0: This Seva does not calculate divisional charts such as the Navamsa, planetary strength (Shadbala), Ashtakavarga, yogas or predictions of events. Rahu and Ketu are the mean lunar nodes. If you want those readings, consult a qualified Vedic astrologer or full chart software.

love.methodTitle: How these percentages are worked out
love.methodBody: Overall = average of the aspect points and the element points. Aspect points: same sign 70, neighbouring signs 55, sextile 75, square 50, trine 90, quincunx 45, opposition 65. Element points: same element 90, Air with Fire or Earth with Water 80, Earth with Fire 55, Air with Water 55, Air with Earth 50, Fire with Water 45. Each person's figure is the overall score plus 4 if the partner's element traditionally feeds theirs (Air feeds Fire, Water nourishes Earth), or minus 4 for the feeding partner.

factors.subtitle: The two individual factors behind the overall result.

0.name: Same sign
0.text: You share the same Sun sign, so you tend to react in similar ways and share the same blind spots. Traditionally this brings instant familiarity, and it can feel like looking in a mirror.

1.name: Neighbouring signs
1.text: Neighbouring signs sit side by side on the zodiac but have different elements and qualities. Traditionally each partner can find the other a little puzzling at first, with plenty to learn from one another.

2.name: Sextile (two signs apart)
2.text: Signs two apart share compatible elements (Fire with Air, or Earth with Water). Traditionally this is a supportive, cooperative link that works well when both put in some effort.

3.name: Square (three signs apart)
3.text: Signs three apart have clashing elements and styles. Traditionally this is a dynamic pairing with friction that can motivate growth when handled with patience.

4.name: Trine (four signs apart)
4.text: Signs four apart share the same element. Traditionally this is the most natural fit, with a similar approach to life and an easy understanding.

5.name: Quincunx (five signs apart)
5.text: Signs five apart share neither element nor quality. Traditionally there is less common ground, so the pairing asks for more conscious adjustment on both sides.

6.name: Opposition (opposite signs)
6.text: Opposite signs sit across the zodiac from each other. Traditionally they are strongly drawn to what the other has, and the lesson is balancing two contrasting approaches.

advice.0: Because you share a Sun sign, notice the habits you have in common and give each other space to grow in different directions.
advice.1: Be curious about how differently the other person sees things; treat the differences as things to learn, not faults to fix.
advice.2: Keep using what already works between you, and put a little regular effort into the areas where you drift apart.
advice.3: Expect some friction and agree how you will handle it, for example a pause before reacting, so that it becomes motivation instead of conflict.
advice.4: Enjoy how naturally you understand each other, and still talk about the things that are easy to take for granted.
advice.5: Name your differences early and adjust on both sides, since there is less in common to rely on by default.
advice.6: Look for balance: each of you has what the other lacks, so share the decisions and appreciate the contrast.

It is not Guna Milan (Ashtakoota), the traditional Indian method that gives a score out of 36 by comparing both people's Moon signs and Nakshatras. p.0: Astrological compatibility is the traditional practice of comparing two people's astrology to see how their themes fit together. The simplest form compares Sun signs. Fuller methods compare whole birth charts (called synastry in Western astrology) or, in Vedic astrology, use the Guna Milan or Ashtakoota system, which scores matches using the Moon sign and nakshatra.
p.1: This Seva uses the simplest method, a comparison of two Sun signs. It suits you if you are curious how two signs traditionally relate, for a partner, friend, family member or colleague. It gives a written reading and no score.

calc.heading: How Is the Compatibility Result Calculated?

p.0: There are two steps, and both are simple rules rather than a score.

list.0: Element pairing. Each sign belongs to Fire, Earth, Air or Water. Two signs of the same element, or Fire with Air, or Earth with Water, are treated as traditionally harmonious. Every other pairing (Fire with Earth, Fire with Water, Earth with Air, Air with Water) is treated as traditionally contrasting.
list.1: Aspect. The twelve signs sit in a circle. Counting the signs between the two people, from 0 to 6 apart, gives the aspect shown in the table.

table.caption: Signs apart and the traditional aspect

after.0: Worked example: Aries and Libra. Aries is the first sign and Libra the seventh, so they are 6 apart, an opposition. Aries is Fire and Libra is Air, a harmonious element pairing. The reading therefore describes magnetic opposites with an energising element mix.
after.1: The Seva deliberately gives no percentage. No recognised formula turns two Sun signs into a single number, so a score would look precise without being meaningful. The written readings are fixed text, so every pair of the same two signs sees the same reading.

list.0: Aspect: the traditional relationship between the two signs. Flowing and supportive describe an easy fit, dynamic and contrasting describe friction that can drive growth, and none of these is better or worse than the others.
list.1: Element pairing: a short note on how the two elements traditionally meet. "Contrasting" means different approaches, not a poor match.
list.2: Conversation starters: general questions for you both, the same for every pair. They are not part of the astrological result.

after.0: Treat the reading as something to talk about together. Real relationships depend on communication, values, timing and effort far more than on two Sun signs, and a Sun sign pairing cannot tell you whether a relationship will last.

lagnaText.Aries: A Mesha Lagna is traditionally linked with energy, courage and a direct, self-starting nature.
lagnaText.Taurus: A Vrishabha Lagna is traditionally linked with steadiness, patience and a love of comfort and beauty.
lagnaText.Gemini: A Mithuna Lagna is traditionally linked with curiosity, quick thinking and a talkative, adaptable nature.
lagnaText.Cancer: A Karka Lagna is traditionally linked with caring, sensitivity and a strong attachment to home and family.
lagnaText.Leo: A Simha Lagna is traditionally linked with confidence, warmth and a natural wish to lead.
lagnaText.Virgo: A Kanya Lagna is traditionally linked with care for detail, practicality and a wish to be useful.
lagnaText.Libra: A Tula Lagna is traditionally linked with fairness, charm and a search for balance and harmony.
lagnaText.Scorpio: A Vrishchika Lagna is traditionally linked with intensity, determination and privacy about feelings.
lagnaText.Sagittarius: A Dhanu Lagna is traditionally linked with optimism, honesty and a love of learning and freedom.
lagnaText.Capricorn: A Makara Lagna is traditionally linked with discipline, responsibility and steady, long-term effort.
lagnaText.Aquarius: A Kumbha Lagna is traditionally linked with independent thinking, friendliness and an interest in the wider community.
lagnaText.Pisces: A Meena Lagna is traditionally linked with imagination, compassion and a gentle, intuitive nature.

moonText.Aries: Mesha Moon: emotions are quick and honest; you may feel best when you are active and free to act.
moonText.Taurus: Vrishabha Moon: emotions are steady; you may feel settled with comfort, routine and loyal people.
moonText.Gemini: Mithuna Moon: the mind is lively; you may feel best when talking, learning and moving between ideas.
moonText.Cancer: Karka Moon: feelings run deep; you may need a safe home and close family to feel at peace. (Moon is in its own sign here.)
moonText.Leo: Simha Moon: you may need appreciation and a sense of dignity, and you tend to feel things warmly and openly.
moonText.Virgo: Kanya Moon: the mind is analytical; you may feel calm when things are orderly and useful.
moonText.Libra: Tula Moon: you may seek harmony and dislike conflict; relationships matter a great deal to your peace of mind.
moonText.Scorpio: Vrishchika Moon: feelings are strong and private; you may take time to trust but are loyal once you do.
moonText.Sagittarius: Dhanu Moon: you may feel best with hope, purpose and room to explore ideas and beliefs.
moonText.Capricorn: Makara Moon: you may keep feelings controlled and feel secure when you are making steady progress.
moonText.Aquarius: Kumbha Moon: you may feel most at ease with space to think independently and friends who share your ideas.
moonText.Pisces: Meena Moon: you may be sensitive and imaginative, and feel deeply for other people.

personality.fire: Pause for three slow breaths before you react.
personality.earth: Try one small new thing each week to stay flexible.

personality.water: Name the feeling in one line before you act on it.

career.fire: Pick one goal and see it through before starting the next.
career.earth: Take one small, calculated step outside your comfort zone each month.

career.water: Keep a short work log, so facts and not moods guide your decisions.

love.fire: Wait ten seconds before replying in a disagreement.
love.earth: Share one feeling out loud each week, even a small one.
love.air: Ask one real question about how someone close to you is feeling.
love.water: Say what hurt you, gently and soon, instead of staying silent.

health.air: Switch screens off 30 minutes before bed.
health.water: Keep a regular sleep time and eat meals at fixed hours.

mercury.careerInfluence: Mercury empowers careers in journalism, writing, technology, education, trading, and all forms of communication. Your mind is your greatest asset — wield it boldly.
mercury.relationshipInfluence: You seek intellectual equal partnerships where words flow freely. Stimulating conversation is your love language. A meeting of minds ignites your deepest connections.
mercury.healthInfluence: Mercury governs the nervous system, lungs, hands, and cognitive function. Mental rest, breathwork, and regular grounding practices keep your quicksilver energy balanced.
mercury.karmicLessons: Express your deepest truths with compassion and precision. Learn that silence is also a form of wisdom. Master the art of listening as deeply as you speak.
mercury.aiInterpretation: Mercury, planet of mind and message, sharpens your perception to a cosmic edge today. Your words carry the power to heal, inspire, and transform. Choose them as a sculptor chooses each stroke — with intention and mastery. The universe is listening to every thought you broadcast.

venus.spiritualMeaning: Love, beauty, harmony, and divine feminine energy

positiveEffects.0: Irresistible magnetic charm that attracts love and abundance
positiveEffects.1: Artistic brilliance and refined aesthetic sense
positiveEffects.2: Social grace that creates harmony everywhere you go
positiveEffects.3: Deep capacity for unconditional love and devotion

challengingEffects.0: Vanity and excessive focus on outward appearances
challengingEffects.1: Over-indulgence in pleasure, comfort, and luxury
challengingEffects.2: Conflict avoidance that allows problems to fester
challengingEffects.3: Emotional dependency and fear of being unloved

venus.careerInfluence: Venus opens doors in art, music, luxury goods, fashion, diplomacy, beauty, and entertainment. Your refined taste and people skills make you a natural in fields where beauty and connection create value.
venus.relationshipInfluence: Venus deepens romantic bonds and calls you to create lasting partnerships through beauty and mutual growth. You thrive in relationships where both partners elevate each other spiritually and emotionally.
venus.healthInfluence: Venus rules the kidneys, skin, throat, hormonal balance, and venous system. Nurture these through hydration, natural beauty rituals, and environments that feel aesthetically peaceful.
venus.karmicLessons: Discover that true beauty radiates from the soul, not the surface. Learn that love begins as a relationship with yourself before it can flourish with another.
venus.aiInterpretation: Venus, cosmic goddess of love and divine beauty, wraps your entire day in golden light today. The universe is arranging encounters, opportunities, and moments of grace in your favor. Open your heart fully — what you radiate from within, you shall attract without. Let beauty be your compass and love be your north star.

earth.spiritualMeaning: Home, grounding, stability, and material manifestation

positiveEffects.0: Unparalleled manifestation power in the physical realm
positiveEffects.1: Deep connection to nature and natural cycles
positiveEffects.2: Steadfast presence that others rely on completely
positiveEffects.3: Material mastery — the ability to build lasting legacies

challengingEffects.1: Over-attachment to material possessions and security
challengingEffects.2: Resistance to spiritual growth in favor of the tangible
challengingEffects.3: Difficulty embracing uncertainty and the unknown

earth.careerInfluence: Earth energy thrives in environmental work, agriculture, architecture, real estate, healing arts, and any field that transforms raw material into lasting structures of beauty and function.
earth.relationshipInfluence: Earth provides the foundation every relationship needs — unwavering stability, deep warmth, and loyalty that endures all seasons. You love through acts of service and presence.
earth.healthInfluence: Earth governs the skeletal system, muscles, digestive health, and overall physical vitality. Time in nature, barefoot grounding, and whole foods align you with Earth's healing frequency.
earth.karmicLessons: Walk between worlds — honor the sacred physical while never forgetting your divine origin. Master the art of manifestation: turning spirit into matter, and matter back into spirit.
earth.aiInterpretation: Earth, your cosmic home and sacred ground, anchors your spirit in the miracle of physical existence today. Feel the intelligence of the living planet beneath you — it holds your history, your healing, and your highest potential. Today, let the Earth remind you: you are not separate from nature. You ARE nature, expressing itself consciously.

mars.spiritualMeaning: Passion, courage, action, and divine masculine energy

positiveEffects.0: Unstoppable drive that achieves what others deem impossible
positiveEffects.1: Fearless leadership that inspires others to rise
positiveEffects.2: Passionate devotion that protects what truly matters
positiveEffects.3: Transformative power to rise from adversity stronger

challengingEffects.0: Uncontrolled anger that damages relationships and opportunities
challengingEffects.2: Tendency toward unnecessary conflict and power struggles
challengingEffects.3: Burn-out from pushing physical and emotional limits too far

mars.careerInfluence: Mars fuels success in entrepreneurship, sports, military leadership, surgery, emergency services, engineering, and any arena demanding courage, decisiveness, and raw competitive energy.
mars.relationshipInfluence: Mars creates passionate, intensely devoted partnerships charged with electricity and depth. You protect what you love with fierce loyalty. However, learning emotional regulation is essential for harmony.
mars.healthInfluence: Mars rules blood, muscles, the adrenal glands, and inflammatory processes in the body. Channel this fiery energy through disciplined physical training, and honor the body's need for recovery.
mars.karmicLessons: Transform the warrior's aggression into the hero's compassionate courage. Learn that the greatest battles are fought within — and the greatest victories are choosing love over ego.
mars.aiInterpretation: Mars, the cosmic warrior and planet of divine courage, activates your deepest source of power today. This is your day to act with bold intention. The universe does not reward the hesitant — it rewards the brave. Channel every ounce of this fierce energy toward your highest purpose, and watch the cosmos clear every obstacle in your path.

jupiter.spiritualMeaning: Expansion, wisdom, abundance, and spiritual growth

positiveEffects.0: Extraordinary luck that bends reality in your favor
positiveEffects.1: Deep philosophical wisdom earned through experience
positiveEffects.2: Abundance consciousness that attracts wealth and opportunity
positiveEffects.3: Spiritual insight that guides others toward their highest path

challengingEffects.0: Overconfidence and excessive optimism without grounded planning
challengingEffects.1: Over-indulgence in all pleasures — excess in every form
challengingEffects.2: Scattered focus from too many simultaneous opportunities
challengingEffects.3: Unrealistic expectations that lead to eventual disappointment

jupiter.careerInfluence: Jupiter opens paths in law, philosophy, higher education, publishing, spirituality, international trade, and any field where wisdom, vision, and expansion create extraordinary value.
jupiter.relationshipInfluence: Jupiter brings boundless joy, spiritual depth, and shared visions of growth to relationships. Your partnerships often feel fated — soulmate connections that expand both individuals beyond known limits.
jupiter.healthInfluence: Jupiter governs the liver, hips, thighs, blood sugar regulation, and the immune system. Conscious moderation — especially in diet and lifestyle — is Jupiter's greatest health teaching.
jupiter.karmicLessons: Expand beyond every limitation you have inherited. Become a teacher of possibility — show others that the universe's abundance is not earned through struggle, but through alignment.
jupiter.aiInterpretation: Jupiter, the great benefactor and cosmic expander of destinies, pours unlimited blessings upon your path today. Every door you approach is already opening. Every seed you plant today contains a forest of potential. This is a day to say YES to expansion, YES to abundance, and YES to the extraordinary life you were born to live. The universe is conspiring entirely in your favor.

saturn.spiritualMeaning: Discipline, karma, time, and divine order

positiveEffects.0: Mastery and excellence built through patient, persistent effort
positiveEffects.1: Enduring success that withstands the test of time
positiveEffects.2: Profound wisdom earned through overcoming adversity
positiveEffects.3: Karmic rewards that arrive precisely when most needed

challengingEffects.0: Painful delays and restrictions that test faith in the process
challengingEffects.1: Heavy responsibilities that feel isolating and overwhelming
challengingEffects.2: Deep-seated fear of failure, scarcity, and inadequacy
challengingEffects.3: Pessimism and rigidity that blocks necessary flow and change

saturn.careerInfluence: Saturn builds legendary careers in government, law, corporate leadership, architecture, banking, and traditional industries. Your rise may be slower than others — but it will be higher and more enduring.
saturn.relationshipInfluence: Saturn calls you toward serious, committed partnerships built on trust, mutual responsibility, and shared growth. These relationships may start slowly but they build into unbreakable bonds across lifetimes.
saturn.healthInfluence: Saturn governs bones, teeth, joints, skin, and the body's structural integrity. Regular discipline — consistent sleep, disciplined nutrition, and skeletal care — honors Saturn's domain.
saturn.karmicLessons: Time is the cosmic currency. What you build with integrity and patience shall outlast everything built with shortcuts. Embrace responsibility not as a burden, but as the sacred architecture of your destiny.
saturn.aiInterpretation: Saturn, the cosmic architect of destiny and keeper of karmic accounts, calls you to rise today to the absolute height of your potential. Every restriction you encounter is a custom-designed curriculum preparing you for your greatest chapter. Do not rush what needs time to become great. Your patience today is tomorrow's mastery. The cosmos rewards every disciplined effort with timeless, irreversible success.

method.0: Scored from each person's Moon sign and Nakshatra using the standard Parashari (North Indian) Ashtakoota tables.
method.1: Varna, Vashya, Tara, Gana and Graha Maitri depend on who is counted first, so the pair is ordered groom first when genders are given as male and female, otherwise in the order entered.
method.2: Yoni uses the full 14-by-14 animal grid (0 to 4 points).
method.3: Tara gives 1.5 points for each direction whose count (remainder after dividing by 9) is not 3, 5 or 7, the classical Vipat, Pratyak and Vadha taras.
method.4: Varna uses the common element rule: water signs Brahmin, fire Kshatriya, earth Vaishya, air Shudra. Some software swaps Vaishya and Shudra.
method.5: Vashya and Gana have more than one published table. This calculation uses one widely published Vashya grid and gives Gana 6 when the first person is Deva and the second Manushya (5 the other way round); other sources reverse that pair.
method.6: Because published tables differ, this score can differ from other Guna Milan calculators. It is a Bhagya calculation and is not claimed to match any particular calculator.
method.7: Sagittarius and Capricorn Vashya groups are split at 15 degrees of the sign.
method.8: Dosha cancellations shown are the commonly cited classical ones; a family astrologer may apply more.

0.question: How can I discover my Rashi?
0.answer: Open Janma Kundali and enter your birth date, time and birthplace. It calculates your Surya Rashi and Chandra Rashi in the Vedic (sidereal) zodiac. The Daily Horoscope section here introduces all twelve signs so you can read about each one.

1.question: What does each sign describe?
1.answer: Every sign page covers its element, ruling planet, symbol and traditional personality themes, along with its strengths and areas to watch. Tap a sign on the wheel to read its profile.

2.question: How do planets relate to the signs?
2.answer: In Vedic astrology each sign is ruled by a planet, for example Mars for Mesha and Venus for Vrishabha. That ruling planet is part of how the sign's qualities are described on its page.

3.question: What can I explore after finding my sign?
3.answer: Read your sign's full profile, then try Janma Kundali for your own Rashi and Nakshatra, or Love Compatibility to see how your sign pairs with someone else's.

4.question: Where can I find daily guidance for my sign?
4.answer: Visit the Daily Horoscope page and choose your sign to read the guidance for today.

0.question: What can I discover from my Janma Kundali?
0.answer: Your Surya Rashi, Chandra Rashi, Janma Nakshatra with its pada, and the Panchang of your birth: Hindu month, Paksha, Tithi, Yoga, Karana and weekday. With an exact birth time you also see your Lagna, the nine grahas in their Rashis and houses, and your current Vimshottari dasha.

1.question: How does my birth time influence my chart?
1.answer: Your birth time fixes your Lagna and the houses, which are the heart of the chart. If you do not know it, you still get the Rashis and Panchang that stay the same through your birth date, and anything that depends on the exact time is clearly marked.

2.question: How does my birth location help create my chart?
2.answer: Your birthplace gives the local time zone and the coordinates needed to place your Lagna and sunrise correctly, so the chart matches the sky at the moment you were born.

3.question: What do the planets and houses represent?
3.answer: The nine grahas stand for different qualities, such as the Sun for self and the Moon for mind, and the twelve houses stand for areas of life. Each graha's Rashi and house is listed in your chart.

4.question: Which details should I look at first?
4.answer: Start with your Chandra Rashi and Janma Nakshatra, which Indian astrology uses for temperament, then your Lagna. After that, explore the Panchang details and your running dasha.

5.question: Can I get guidance about career and relationships?
5.answer: Yes. Ask Divya Margdarshak from the "Need More Guidance?" box under your chart. Your result is shared with the question so the answer can refer to it.

0.question: How does Love Compatibility compare two people?
0.answer: It works out each person's sun sign from their birth date, then compares the two signs' elements and the traditional aspect between them.

1.question: Which details are needed for both partners?
1.answer: A name and a complete date of birth for each person. Gender is optional and is collected separately for each partner. It does not change the comparison.

2.question: What parts of a relationship does it explore?
2.answer: Your result shows the aspect between the two signs, how their elements pair, and a set of questions to talk about together.

3.question: How should we read the results?
3.answer: Read them as conversation starters. There is no single score, so focus on the themes you both recognise and use the questions at the end to talk things through.

4.question: What can we explore to strengthen our relationship?
4.answer: Each of you can open Janma Kundali for your own Rashi and Nakshatra, and you can ask Divya Margdarshak about the result from the "Need More Guidance?" box.

explainer.heading: How Is Your Naamank Calculated?
explainer.what: What is Chaldean numerology? It is an old system in which every letter is given a traditional number from 1 to 8 (there is no 9 on letters). Your name is turned into one number by adding the values of its letters. p.0: Tarot is a deck of illustrated cards used for reflection and storytelling. Each card carries traditional themes such as new beginnings, choices, endings or support. It is an aid for thinking a question through, not a way of proving what will happen.

list.0: Choose a reading: Tarot Bhagya (five cards, with a life area such as Career or Love) or Karma Mirror (three cards).
list.1: Shuffle if you like, then pick the cards that draw you from the fanned deck and watch them turn over.
list.2: Read the interpretation written for exactly those cards in their positions. Tap any card to see its general meaning.

after.0: Selection is random: your browser shuffles the 22 Major Arcana cards and cards are always read upright. The card names, positions and life area are sent to a language model, which writes the interpretation, so its wording can differ between readings.

p.0: Treat the later positions as themes to prepare for, not events that are certain. In Karma Mirror, “karma” is a lens for recurring patterns, not a claim about past lives. Notice what feels true, and use the suggested steps or ignore them. Your own judgement matters most.

education.title: About Hasta Rekha (Palmistry)
education.disclaimer: Palm reading is offered for personal interest, cultural exploration and reflection. It is a traditional practice that is not scientifically proven, and the result is not a prediction, a medical assessment or professional advice.

p.0: Palm reading, or palmistry, is a traditional practice of interpreting the shape of the hand, the lines on the palm and the raised areas called mounts. It is found in many cultures, including the Indian tradition often called Hasta Samudrika Shastra.
p.1: Palm reading is a belief system and is not scientifically proven. People use it for reflection and conversation. This Seva covers one small part of it, which is hand shape.

b1.heading: How Does Palm Reading Work on Bhagya Astro?

list.0: Upload a photo of your palm or use your camera for a live scan.
list.1: Your device detects your hand and finds 21 landmark points, such as your knuckles and fingertips.
list.2: The Seva measures your palm's width and length, your finger lengths and your thumb angle from those points.
list.3: From the measurements it works out your hand shape (Earth, Air, Water or Fire) and shows the traditional description of that shape, along with the numbers it used.

after.0: The Seva does not read the lines or marks on your palm, and it does not use generated text to interpret your photo. The hand detection is a machine-learning model that runs in your browser, and everything after that is fixed rules and fixed text.

b2.heading: What Information or Images Are Required?

list.0: One photo of your palm, as a JPG, PNG or WebP file up to 10 MB. You can instead allow camera access for a live scan.
list.1: A clear photo works best: the whole palm facing the camera, fingers slightly spread, even lighting, and the hand large enough in the frame.
list.2: No name, birth details or account are needed.

after.0: Before measuring, the Seva checks that a hand is detected, the detection is confident, the image is not too blurry and the hand is not too small. If a check fails it tells you why and asks for another photo. A photo that is not an image, or is not a supported type or size, is turned away before anything is analysed.

p.0: Your hand shape is classified with two measurements. The palm ratio is the palm's width divided by its length, and a ratio of {{squareMin}} or more counts as a square palm. The finger ratio is the average of your four finger lengths divided by the palm length, and a ratio of {{longMin}} or more counts as long fingers.

after.0: Worked example: a palm ratio of 0.90 is square, and a finger ratio of 0.74 is short, so the hand is classed as Earth. These cut-off points are the Seva's own simple rules based on the classical descriptions, and a hand near a cut-off can fall on either side depending on the photo.
after.1: For background, palmistry traditionally links the heart line with emotion, the head line with thinking, the life line with vitality and the fate line with direction in work. This Seva does not detect or read any of them, and it does not interpret mounts.

table.caption: Hand shape rules used by the Seva

list.0: Hand shape: a traditional description of temperament. Treat it as one lens for reflection and keep what resonates.
list.1: The measurements: the numbers that led to your hand shape. If they change when you take another photo, that is because of camera angle, finger spread or distance.
list.2: Hand in the photo: whether you photographed a left or right hand. The Seva cannot tell which of your hands is dominant, and the reading is the same either way.

after.0: The reading does not describe your future, health, career or relationships, and it should not be used to make decisions about any of them.
